fusions.name: Clutching Jab
fusions.desc: A gripping jab with spiked fingers that deals 5 damage, slows the target by 15% for 1.5 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Closed Fist
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. You close a spiked fist around it, dealing 22 damage and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Catch the Blow
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs up to 20 damage for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 6% while it holds.

fusions.name: Spined Gauntlet
fusions.desc: Conjures a gauntlet with spined knuckles: you attack 6% faster, your critical chance rises by 3%, your critical hits deal 0.1x more, and each kill returns 3 health.
